message.detail: Action id missing or not canonical; cannot correlate a reply.
Inbound frame was not valid UTF-8 JSON text.

negative.name: wrong_type_expected_revision_string
negative.why: expected_revision must be an integer but is given as a string.

negative.name: missing_required_field_action_without_kind
negative.why: action requires the 'kind' field, which is absent.

negative.name: extra_undocumented_field_hello_client_name
negative.why: hello has additionalProperties false and there is intentionally no client_name field; client_name is NOT allowed.

negative.name: bad_enum_action_kind_spin
negative.why: 'spin' is not a member of the kind enum (left, right, down, cw, ccw, hold).

negative.name: lexical_float_revision
negative.why: revision is given as 1.0, a lexical float. JSON Schema 'integer' MAY accept 1.0 because its value is integral, so the schema alone does not necessarily reject this; strict runtime typing requires a JSON-decoded Python int and rejects the float. This case is documented RUNTIME-ONLY and is NOT asserted to be schema-rejected.

negative.name: board_wrong_size_19_rows
negative.why: board must contain exactly 20 rows but only 19 are provided.

negative.name: occupied_cell_negative_row
negative.why: An occupied cell has a negative row (-1). Occupied cells must be absolute on-board cells with rows 0..19; only the anchor/origin may be negative.

negative.name: occupied_cell_column_out_of_range
negative.why: An occupied cell has column 10, which is off the 10-wide board (columns 0..9).

negative.name: duplicate_occupied_cells_not_four_distinct
negative.why: cells has four items but two are identical [1,4], so it is not four distinct cells.

negative.name: playing_state_with_null_active_piece
negative.why: status is playing but active_piece is null; a playing state frame must carry a non-null active piece.

negative.name: game_over_state_with_non_null_active_piece
negative.why: status is game_over but active_piece is a non-null object; a terminal state frame must carry a null active piece.

negative.name: gravity_interval_zero
negative.why: gravity_interval_ms is 0, below the inclusive lower bound of 100 implied by max(100, 500 - 50*(level-1)).

negative.name: gravity_interval_above_max
negative.why: gravity_interval_ms is 600, above the inclusive upper bound of 500.

negative.name: unsafe_integer_revision
negative.why: revision exceeds the safe-integer ceiling 9007199254740991 (2^53 - 1), so it is a JS-imprecise magnitude.

negative.name: unsafe_integer_level
negative.why: level 100001 exceeds the documented ceiling of 100000.

negative.name: unsafe_integer_score
negative.why: score exceeds the safe-integer ceiling 9007199254740991 (2^53 - 1).

negative.name: unsafe_integer_total_lines
negative.why: total_lines exceeds the safe-integer ceiling 9007199254740991 (2^53 - 1).

negative.name: win_with_null_winner
negative.why: result is win but winning_seat is null; a win must name both distinct seats.

negative.name: win_same_seat_both_sides
negative.why: result is win but winning_seat and losing_seat are the same seat; they must be distinct.

negative.name: draw_with_winner
negative.why: result is draw but winning_seat is non-null; a draw must have all three seat fields null.

negative.name: forfeit_wrong_loser
negative.why: result is forfeit but losing_seat (A) does not equal forfeiting_seat (B); the loser must equal the forfeiter and the winner must be the other seat.

negative.name: action_id_leading_zero
negative.why: action_id ordinal has a leading zero (A-01); the canonical grammar ^(A|B)-([1-9][0-9]{0,14})$ forbids leading zeros.

negative.name: action_id_one_past_max
negative.why: action_id ordinal A-1000000000000000 has sixteen digits, one past the 15-digit maximum ordinal 999999999999999, so it fails the canonical grammar pattern.

negative.name: action_id_seat_prefix_mismatch
negative.why: seat_id is A but action_id is B-3; the per-seat if/then seat-prefix rule on ActionMessage requires the action_id prefix to equal seat_id.

negative.name: ack_applied_false
negative.why: ack carries applied:false; an ack is always an acceptance, so applied is const true and a non-acceptance must be a reject, not an ack.

negative.name: action_before_start_waiting
negative.why: This action message is itself schema-valid; it exercises the RUNTIME waiting-gate rule. An action received while the room_status is waiting is rejected at runtime with reason not_started WITHOUT mutating the board, advancing the per-seat revision, or consuming the seat's action ordinal / high-water mark. The schema cannot observe room status from a single inbound action, so this is a documented RUNTIME-only obligation, not a schema rejection.

negative.name: action_id_trailing_lf
negative.why: action_id has a trailing LF (\n). The canonical grammar uses a trailing negative lookahead instead of \$, so no character may follow the ordinal; a trailing line terminator is rejected.

negative.name: action_id_trailing_cr
negative.why: action_id has a trailing CR (\r); rejected because no character may follow the ordinal.

negative.name: action_id_trailing_crlf
negative.why: action_id has a trailing CRLF (\r\n); rejected because no character may follow the ordinal.

negative.name: action_id_trailing_ls
negative.why: action_id has a trailing U+2028 LINE SEPARATOR; rejected because no character may follow the ordinal.

negative.name: action_id_trailing_ps
negative.why: action_id has a trailing U+2029 PARAGRAPH SEPARATOR; rejected because no character may follow the ordinal.
